name: becker_feasibility_by_arm

verdict.detail: GUCA2A clears the floor (0.079 -> 0.148) but its enrichment (+0.669) sits INSIDE the band the controls describe (+0.517 to +0.739). The label selected deeper nuclei, not mature ones, so the gate was cleared by library size. The replication is NOT licensed on this reading. Genuinely enriched, for contrast: MS4A12, MS4A12, MS4A12.

mature_label.why: invariant 2 — a target gene in the label returns the threshold it was given. The whole panel is excluded so the controls stay usable inside the label.

scope: the normal arm, but not its mature cells, which is what the prereg names. Mature cells enrich for these markers, so this is still a lower bound on the pre-registered gate. Detection for every arm is in the by_arm table.
